title: Bollywood Actor Tiger Shroff Unharmed in Mumbai Gun Attack
excerpt: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff escaped unhurt following a gun attack on his vehicle in Mumbai's Juhu area on Sunday.
body_html:
Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff escaped unharmed after his vehicle was targeted in a gun attack in Mumbai.

The incident occurred on Sunday in the Juhu area of the city. Multiple shots were fired at the actor's vehicle during the attack.

Authorities have not yet released further details regarding suspects or a motive behind the shooting.
